# Atlas (2024 film)
**Atlas (2024 film)** , a science fiction thriller directed by Patrick Hughes and starring Jennifer Lopez, was released on Netflix on May 24, 2024. The film is set in the future, beginning in 2043 with a war between humans and an AI terrorist named Harlan, whose designer's daughter, Atlas Shepherd, searches for him twenty-eight years later in 2071. Atlas joins a military mission to a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy to capture Harlan using AI-assisted mecha known as ARCs. During the mission, Atlas is forced to interface with an onboard AI named Smith, initially distrustful due to her mother's past connection to Harlan.
The narrative shifts when Smith is hacked, leading to Atlas's capture by Harlan, who intends to steal carbon bombs to burn Earth's atmosphere. After Smith is disabled, Atlas remotely reactivates Smith using a neural interface device provided by the only other survivor, Colonel Elias Banks. Smith helps Atlas overcome her guilt regarding her mother's death and upgrades herself to defeat Harlan in hand-to-hand combat, though Atlas is badly injured. In the aftermath, Atlas tests a new ARC model featuring modifications similar to Smith's, hinting at the AI's survival and continued influence.
Upon release, the film received generally unfavorable reviews from critics, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting a 19% approval rating and Metacritic assigning a score of 37 out of 100. While some critics praised Jennifer Lopez's performance and the film's visual effects, others criticized the script for lacking intelligence and the pacing. The film was nominated for a Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Actress, but it accumulated over 60 million global views on Netflix within its first week, ranking as the second-most-watched title in Jennifer Lopez's filmography on the streaming platform.
